_comment: Owner Lake Michigan dunes direction, 2026-09-28. Default-off local/static visual candidate pending native capture review. Sleeping Bear Dunes NPS photos guide sandy gaps, upright straw/sage grass and sheltered woodland; no photographic pixels or new models. Runtime copies only: source ground-cover/vegetation configs, terrain bake, routes, harvest and collision remain unchanged. Veilfall's static mountain vegetation and authored groves retain their existing treatment.
_comment_colonies: Unjudged fuller dune tuft candidate: eight pointed leaves, three short wider basal leaves and three closely grouped stem bases. Compare against zero-shift coverage with the existing five-leaf mesh. Default-off; ordinary profiles, terrain and gameplay remain unchanged.

ground_cover._comment_colony_shape: Unjudged coverage proposal: independently warped bare gaps cut whole colonies; sparse pioneers soften their margins and extend only onto dry painted shore. The unjudged zero-shift candidate retains the existing colony ramp at low elevation while removing its coastal probability ceiling. Sparse pioneers retain the coastal probability ceiling. The same 1-3m dry-height fade applies to all eligible ground, avoiding a shore/grass paint-density edge; forbidden-ground and clearance rules remain unchanged. Rock, wet-height, holes and all existing built/anchor/camp clearances remain enforced. No terrain/control-map changes. The separate dune_tuft_shape recipe changes only the grass mesh and tuft count.

shelter._comment: Canopy and understory share deterministic centres accepted by both original ground/slope/clearance rules. Existing lee bounds remain unchanged. An upwind ridge must rise at least ridge_relief_m above the centre; bounded unsuccessful searches report zero groves with no fallback placement.
